description: Self-contained on purpose: this tree is public, so no private preset references.

An UPSTREAM_REF bump is a release event for the overlay: CI reassembles from the new tag, git am names the first conflicting patch, and the smoke proves the multi-replica contract. Review, never automerge.
The BASE_IMAGE ARG in docker/Dockerfile is covered by the built-in dockerfile manager; keep it in lockstep with UPSTREAM_REF in the same MR.

customManagers.description: Pinned upstream jellyfin release the overlay reassembles from
